mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (as measured by the 20-day return distribution).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer and housing demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of severe industrial production contraction (INDPRO decline > 10% year-over-year), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risks and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines > 10% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST declines > 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which correlates with reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 1.0%), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank's policy rate is at the effective lower bound and further easing is unlikely, reducing uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 5% signals a sharp slowdown in manufacturing activity, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO declines > 5% in a month.
